name: Runaway Hill Inn (listed as Runaway Hill Club)
brand_truth: A 1946 English manor on Harbour Island's high ground above Pink Sands Beach, where every room carries a name.
buyer: US East Coast couples and small family groups (HHI $250k+) planning 2-6 months ahead on a phone; Infinity House for multi-family groups; destination wedding couples.

design.hero_pattern: framed-image passe-partout with name in a paper notch and glass room-key card
design.signature: Sticky scroll descent from the Main House to pool, staircase and Pink Sands Beach (SVG section with walking marker + real photos), a filterable room register, and a stay estimator that writes the enquiry email

current_site_findings: Homepage shows no phone, address or email.
Rates pop-up has a typo: Room 7 shows $500 and $550.00 with tax, not the 30% used everywhere else.
Activities page uses a stock photo captioned Barbuda, Antigua & Barbuda.
Name split online (Inn vs Club) and acreage conflicts (10 vs 11 acres).
No room comparison: twelve separate pages to choose a room.
No getting-here guidance (North Eleuthera airport, taxi, water taxi).
pitch_line: Your guests choose rooms by name, so we built the site around that: every room, its bed and its rate in one register, and an enquiry that writes itself to your reservations inbox.
assumptions: Published rates are per night (implied by the daily/weekly Infinity House line)
Room amenities listed on the Jacqueline Jean page apply across rooms
Lyon Holland (room 11) is the Owner's Cottage
notes: Business trades as Runaway Hill Inn; prospect list says Club, kept as alternateName in JSON-LD. Room 7 after-tax figure on their site is inconsistent; the estimator uses base x 1.3. Guest quote is from their own homepage (Caroline C.), attributed. Photos hotlinked from runawayhill.com; their stock 'Barbuda' image deliberately not used. Acreage omitted because sources disagree (10, 11, 9.365). Elite Traveler is the source for 175 ft beachfront, ~30 ft elevation, pool steps down from the house, ELH + water taxi. Scorecard: 1:4 2:5 3:4 4:5 5:4 6:4 7:4 8:4 9:4 10:5 11:5.
